mapper.sql: id, post_id, user_id, username, avatar, is_anonymous, content, parent_id, reply_to_comment_id, status, like_count, reply_count, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `comment` WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT FROM `comment` WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND parent_id IS NULL AND status = 1 ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `comment` WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND parent_id IS NULL AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `comment` WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `comment` ( post_id, user_id, username, avatar, is_anonymous, content, parent_id, reply_to_comment_id, status, like_count, reply_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{avatar}, #{isAnonymous}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{replyToCommentId}, 1, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE `comment` SET status = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1
UPDATE `comment` SET status = 2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE `comment` SET like_count = like_count + #{delta}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND like_count + #{delta} >= 0
UPDATE `comment` SET reply_count = reply_count + #{delta}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND parent_id IS NULL AND status = 1 AND reply_count + #{delta} >= 0
